description: Logic gates — AND, OR and XOR on a pair of inputs each, an inverter, and the negated form of all four

params.text: Sets the voltage an input has to pass to count as true, 0V to 10V for every input at once

inputs.text: One of the two inputs to the AND pair
One of the two inputs to the OR pair
One of the two inputs to the XOR pair

outputs.text: 10V while both AND inputs are above the threshold, and 0V otherwise
0V while both AND inputs are above the threshold, and 10V otherwise
10V while either OR input is above the threshold, and 0V while neither is
0V while either OR input is above the threshold, and 10V while neither is
10V while exactly one of the XOR inputs is above the threshold, and 0V while both or neither are
0V while exactly one of the XOR inputs is above the threshold, and 10V while both or neither are
10V while the inverter input is below the threshold, and 0V while it is above
